one_line: Enterprise deal-management and investment CRM with a partner/enterprise REST API, Python SDK, and an announced MCP server.
auth_notes: API keys plus an authorization token for requests; docs cover getting started, API keys, auth token, pagination, rate limits. Official Python SDK provided. Access is partner/enterprise only - credentials are issued to DealCloud customers/partners, not self-serve.
self_serve_notes: Gated - requires a DealCloud partnership or client relationship; must contact sales/DealCloud to obtain credentials.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Schema, entry types, fields, cells, rows, views, history, files, reports, user management, publications/real-time events
api_surface.webhook_note: Publications/subscription model for real-time events from DealCloud (documented under 'Real-Time Events from DealCloud')

existing_mcp.note: Docs announce a DealCloud MCP Server (client preview starting July 2026) with a dedicated MCP section covering auth and available tools

blocker: API access gated behind DealCloud partnership/client credentials (contact sales); no self-serve signup.

evidence.note: Fetched docs nav confirmed API keys, auth token, Python SDK, MCP server preview, and full API surface

agent_notes: Docs are excellent and MCP is officially coming, but credentials require an enterprise/partner relationship - main friction.
